item.title: Valve Warns of a Possible Steam Machine Price Hike
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: As computer components get more expensive, Valve warns its Steam Machine might get more expensive as it struggles to meet demand for the 2TB model.
item.content:encoded: Video game hardware manufacturers have been impacted by the computer component crisis, with Nintendo, PlayStation, and Xbox all raising the prices of their consoles this year. PC gaming giant Valve has increased the cost of its Steam Deck, and its PC-but-looks-like-a-console Steam Machine ended up being more expensive than Valve originally intended. Now, Valve has warned that its Steam Machine might get a price hike while opening up purchases for the cheapest model.

item.title: GTA 6 Gamble to Get Army Soldiers to Reenlist Actually Worked
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: The US Army offered soldiers a four-day GTA 6 weekend as a reenlistment incentive. Here’s why 43 soldiers signed up.
item.content:encoded: With Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launching, some fans are booking time off work, while others are making considerably bigger commitments to secure a few uninterrupted days in Vice City. According to reporting from Task & Purpose, 43 soldiers from the U.S. Army's 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion at Fort Stewart, Georgia, have signed up for a special reenlistment incentive offering a four-day weekend to play GTA 6 when it launched on Nov. 19.

item.title: Steam Makes Strategy RPG Masterpiece Free For a Limited Time
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Crusader Kings 3 is free to play on Steam until Nov. 23, with a 70% discount available for players who want to keep it.
item.content:encoded: Steam is giving PC strategy fans another opportunity to try a major grand strategy game without spending a cent. This week's promotion is particularly appealing for players who enjoy medieval history, political intrigue, and building a dynasty from the ground up.

item.title: GTA 6 Shows Why You Should Never, Ever, Ever Text and Drive (Ever)
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: You can pull off a lot of crimes in Grand Theft Auto 6, but texting and driving might be the most dangerous one of all.
item.content:encoded: You can pull off a lot of heinous crimes in Grand Theft Auto 6. Stealing a car, mugging an old lady at gunpoint, killing a bird and then beating up a cop with its corpse. All of those are sure to earn you at least a one-star Wanted level. But there’s an even worse crime in GTA 6 that you’ll probably wind up doing more than murder: texting and driving.

item.title: Jordan Peele Might Be Bringing Back One of Horror’s Biggest Franchises
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Is Jordan Peele involved in the new A Nightmare on Elm Street reboot? A cryptic Monkeypaw video has fans speculating.
item.content:encoded: Jordan Peele has become one of the biggest names in modern horror, with his films Get Out, Us, and Nope helping establish him as one of the genre's most recognizable filmmakers. Through his production company, Monkeypaw Productions, Peele has also helped bring several other horror projects to the big screen, including Candyman, Monkey Man, and Him.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson’s Mistborn TTRPG Solves the Biggest Problem With Licensed Games
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: The wildly ambitious campaign takes generations
item.content:encoded: Licensed tabletop role-playing games provide players with a new way to experience their favorite franchises like Star Wars, Star Trek, and the Lord of the Rings. But those adventures always come with a big question about how player characters are supposed to make their mark on stories that already have their own legendary heroes. Rather than erasing canon characters or turning them into quest-givers, the wildly ambitious Mistborn Legacy campaign for the Cosmere Roleplaying Game allows players to forge legends as powerful as any of Brandon Sanderson’s characters.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals the Commander Trend He Wants to See More Of
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: Magic Gavin Verhey explains how Maralen, Fae Ascendant’s success made him want to design more Commanders that pair two creature types.
item.content:encoded: While at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026, one of the trickier Magic: The Gathering Commander decks I faced was led by Maralen, Fae Ascendant, from Lorwyn Eclipsed. Currently the 40th most popular Commander, according to data from EDHREC, Maralen is a typal Commander, meaning that her abilities emphasize creature types. In this case, she’s all about two kinds of creatures rather than just one. Specifically, this is an elves and faeries Commander. Since her color identity has three colors — black, green, and blue — that gives every Maralen deck access to a wide variety of both creature types to leverage some big payoffs.

item.title: 'GTA 6' Is Triggering Men Who Are Learning How To Have A Girlfriend
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: GTA 6 fans weren't expecting that keeping Lucia happy would require any actual work on Jason's part despite Rockstar's focus on the relationship
item.content:encoded: Young men in relationships around the world have spent the last few weeks warning their significant others about Nov. 19. On that day, and for their forseeable future, the men in their lives would be MIA, they said. They wouldn't answer texts. They weren't going to hang out. Many women were told to accept that men would put little to no effort into their relationships for a while as they focused entirely on Grand Theft Auto 6.

item.title: GTA 6's Free PC Competitor Is Blowing Up on Steam
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 for PC isn't happening anytime soon, but more than 500,000 Steam users are playing GTA 6's free alternative, Rob Run.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6is finally here — but only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, with PC gamers still waiting for Rockstar Games to officially announce a port of the game. While Grand Theft Auto 5 and GTA Online have been a hit on Steam, Rockstar seems to be in no hurry to bring GTA 6 to PC. Reportedly, though, that will happen sometime in 2027.

item.title: The Game Awards’ Biggest GOTY Snub Has Been Officially Redeemed
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Crimson Desert was snubbed by The 2026 Game Awards but just took home a ton of accolades anyway
item.content:encoded: This week, Geoff Keighley announced the nominees for the 2026 Game Awards. With only six games making the cut for Game of the Year, several major titles were inevitably left out. Pearl Abyss' massive RPG Crimson Desertwas one of the biggest snubs, especially since it'salready racking up wins at other events.

item.title: Surprising No One, GTA 6's Comedy Is All Over the Place
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: GTA 6 is the latest Grand Theft Auto to continue Rockstar's pedigree of satirizing literally everyone across the whole political spectrum. Yay...
item.content:encoded: More than being deviously fun crime sandboxes, every Grand Theft Auto game also acts as a snapshot of American culture at the time of its release. These games have never pulled any punches, taking swings at everything from the paparazzi to politics to the most innocuous corners of pop culture. GTA 6 was sure to take the same shots, but at a time when the targets are moving faster than ever. Could a game that has been in the works for more than a decade possibly have humor that felt up to date? Would it be careful to punch up rather than turn the country’s most vulnerable people into punchlines? And would it have the stones to take on President Donald Trump, a man who has dominated America’s political culture throughout the game’s entire development cycle?

item.title: New Fallout Game Leaks and Is Puzzling Players
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: The Australian Classification Board just leaked a new Fallout game.
item.content:encoded: It’s been more than a decade since the last mainline single-player Fallout game, and fans are feverish for what’s next. While Fallout: New Vegas developer Obsidian has already announced that it is working on a new game, there’s no telling how long it will take for this untitled project to be released. If you're waiting for Fallout 5, don't hold your breath. Bethesda likely won't begin serious work on the game until it finishes The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel. However, a leak from the Australian Classification Board reveals a bizarre new Fallout game in development.

item.title: GTA 6 Brings Back a Legendary Rockstar Easter Egg
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 brings back the Bigfoot easter egg.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 has only been out for hours, but players have already started discovering plenty of hidden details, including strange side quests and callbacks to previous games. A lucky few are reporting sightings of a creature that needs to be seen to be believed: Bigfoot.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Cuts A Controversial Franchise Feature After 25 Years
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: The suggestive mechanic absent in GTA 6 has appeared in many GTA games, across multiple hardware generations
item.content:encoded: You can do anything you want in a Grand Theft Auto game, but the franchise has historically been defined by a handful of specific mechanics. Steal a car. Shoot pedestrians. And for better or worse, soliciting a prostitute. Grand Theft Auto 6, however, is an unusually realistic game that tells a humane story about a couple, and those shifts in approach are reflected in the game's actions.

item.title: The 10 greatest games to never get a GOTY nomination
item.dc:creator: Lillian Ali
item.description: If your favorite game wasn’t nominated, you’re not alone.
item.content:encoded: The Game Awards announced its 2026 nominations yesterday, though not without controversy. Grand Theft Auto 6 — a game that isn't even out yet — leads the pack with eight nominations, including Game of the Year. No indies managed to get a GOTY nomination this year, despite the release of acclaimed games like Mina the Hollower and Big Walk. Several blockbusters — including Polygon favorites like Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave and Pokémon Pokopia — were also snubbed for the night's biggest award.

item.title: PlayStation Network Outage Hits On GTA 6 Release Day Eve
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: PS5 users are reporting widespread technical issues during GTA 6's window as millions try and download Rockstar's open-world shooter.
item.content:encoded: What happens when a potential 250 million people try logging into a server at the same time? Problems, that's what. Thursday, Nov. 19 is the official release day for Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, and it appears Sony's platform, commonly known as PlayStation Network, is already buckling the day before under enormous demand for the world's most hyped game.

item.title: GTA 6's Completely Unrealistic Mountains Had to Be in the Game, Rockstar Says
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Much of Grand Theft Auto 6's Leonida is an accurate representation of Florida, except for one big geographical change.
item.content:encoded: If you’ve ever spent time in and around Miami, Grand Theft Auto 6is bound to delight you. Rockstar Games spared no expense in bringing the diverse world of Florida to life in digital form. Walk down the street in Vice City, and you’re sure to find an approximation of a bar you’ve actually been to. Head to the Leonida Keys, and you’ll find rows of houses on stilts. The attention to detail is impressive, but it also makes one odd detail about the map a little odd.

item.title: Switch 2 Is Getting an All-new Gamecube Controller
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.category: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Nintendo Switch
item.description: 8BitDo is releasing a new wireless gamepad for the Switch 2 and PC modeled after the GameCube controller.
item.content:encoded: Super Smash Bros. fans, this one’s for you. Peripheral maker 8BitDo just revealed the GC Bluetooth Gamepad, a wireless spin on the GameCube controller meant for Nintendp Switch, Switch 2, and Windows PC. It’s available in the GameCube’s iconic purple-and-orange color palette and features the "classic GC design and iconic button layout," according to its product description. The controller can connect wirelessly via Bluetooth 5.0 or a 2.4 GHz adapter, and has wired support via a USB-C cable. All three connection types work with the original Switch and Switch 2, while only wired and 2.4 GHz wireless connections work on PC. The controller goes for $49.99 and ships on Dec. 10, 2026.

item.title: Skyrim's Most Iconic Region Is Making a Major Comeback
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Bethesda reveals Winterhold is The Elder Scrolls Online’s next major zone, arriving with Season Three in 2027.
item.content:encoded: Winter is coming to Tamriel, and The Elder Scrolls Online is preparing to take players somewhere particularly familiar. One of the most memorable regions from The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim is making its way to the MMORPG, giving fans another reason to revisit the icy northern reaches of the continent.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals the Biggest Problem With Marvel’s Infinity Stones
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: The Infinity Stones show the challenges of Universes Beyond
item.content:encoded: When Magic: The Gathering‘s Marvel’s Spider-Man set launched in 2025, the inclusion of The Soul Stone hinted at the scope of Wizards of the Coast’s partnership with Marvel. Including one of the six cosmically powerful gems as the set’s headliner card practically guaranteed the rest would eventually be released, a plan that was confirmed with the printing of The Mind Stone in the 2026 Marvel Super Heroes set. It’s a clever strategy, but one that Magic head game designer Mark Rosewater told Polygon demonstrates a problem with Universes Beyond design.

item.title: Christopher Nolan Reveals Why Watching 'The Odyssey' at Home Is Better than IMAX
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: Christopher Nolan explains why The Odyssey rewards repeat viewings, what to watch for in the performances, and how to create a home theater.
item.content:encoded: Christopher Nolan has spent much of his career championing the theatrical experience. From shooting on IMAX film to encouraging audiences to see his movies on the biggest screens possible, the director has made no secret of his belief that movies are meant to be experienced in theaters.

item.title: 2026’s Best-Sci Fi Movie Is Officially Returning to IMAX
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Project Hail Mary is returning to IMAX in December as the Ryan Gosling sci-fi film kicks off its awards push.
item.content:encoded: Sometimes a movie's spectacle is so great that it really does need to be experienced in a theater, preferably in the best possible format available to you. Project Hail Mary, this year's stunning Andy Weir adaptation starring Ryan Gosling, is one such movie. It may have been difficult to catch in IMAX, however, as IMAX screens are a hot commodity and the film has been out of theaters for a while. If you missed it the first time around, Amazon MGM Studios has an end-of-year treat for you.

item.title: GTA 6 Withholds Your 100% Stats Until the End — For Good Reason
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 hides your 100% completion tasks until the very end, a move designed to keep players from getting overwhelmed.
item.content:encoded: Completionists beware: Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to take you a very, very long time to complete. Rockstar Game’s open-world game is filled to the brim with things to do, see, and collect. You can go golfing, collect undersea treasures, find collectible trading cards, rack up medals at shooting ranges, scan landmarks, and so much more. Rockstar knows that it could get overwhelming fast, so GTA 6 was designed to combat that in one key way.

item.title: GTA 6 Is Already Breaking Twitch Records
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: GTA 6 breaks Twitch viewership records with 3.29 million viewers and attracts nearly 7.9 million across streaming platforms.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 is already rewriting streaming history. Rockstar Games' highly anticipated sequel has attracted 3.29 million concurrent viewers on Twitch, breaking the platform's previous record for a video game launch as its global rollout continues.

item.title: GTA 6 Won’t Be Getting a Future Performance Mode, Even on PS5 Pro
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: GTA 6 will be locked at 30 FPS on current consoles and won't get a future performance mode, even on PS5 Pro.
item.content:encoded: In a rough turn of events for frame rate diehards, it seems Grand Theft Auto 6 won’t get a patch that boosts its frame rate at the expense of graphical fidelity. Speaking with Kotaku, Rockstar confirmed the game will not receive a performance mode on modern consoles, even on the beefier PlayStation 5 Pro.

item.title: GTA 6's Hidden Drug System Is Surprisingly Deep
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: GTA 6's NPCs quietly do much more around Leonida than the player can see, Rockstar revealed
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6might be known as a crime simulator, but Rockstar's open-world game is truly a sandbox full of systems. Some of these features, like the game's vast NPC generation system, are immediately apparent when you play. Others, like GTA 6's drug system, are borderline invisible — they're never mentioned in the game, and may be impossible to track.

item.title: New Friday the 13th Movie Reveals All-New Jason, Dutton Ranch Star for Cast
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: New Friday the 13th movie reveals release date and cast, including Jason and the film’s final girl, Dutton Ranch star Natalie Alyn Lind.
item.content:encoded: Just last week, Horror, Inc. announced that Jason Voorhees would be returning in a new Friday the 13th movie. The initial announcement for the lucky 13th entry in the franchise revealed that series veteran Steve Miner would be returning to direct the horror feature. Now we have a lot more details about what to expect when Jason returns next year, with the release date and cast details finally revealed.

item.title: Resident Evil's Pedestrian monster wasn't actually a practical effect
item.dc:creator: Jake Kleinman
item.description: Despite reports otherwise, the viral motion test for Resident Evil's Pedestrian didn't make it into the movie, says Weta VFX Supervisor Kevin Smith. But the effect was convincing!
item.content:encoded: Despite reports otherwise, the viral motion test for Resident Evil's Pedestrian didn't make it into the movie, says Weta VFX Supervisor Kevin Smith. But the effect was convincing!

item.title: As GTA 6 Breaks Records, Rockstar Devs Call for Union Recognition
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 developers are making a plea for unionization ahead of the game’s release.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 will almost certainly set sales records when it launches tomorrow, Nov. 19. However, despite the windfall for Rockstar Games, many of the studio’s employees remain worried about their jobs. In an opinion piece from The Guardian, Rockstar animation programmer Nestor Uriarte outlined the benefits of unionization as developers at the studio await the results of an ongoing union vote. 1,600 staff in the U.K. have until Nov. 26 to cast their ballots.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered the Most Evil Crime in the Game
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: Just like in Red Dead Redemption 2, it seems like there are plenty of ways for a sincere oopsie in GTA 6 to spiral out of control fast.
item.content:encoded: The long-awaited Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't technically come out until midnight local time on Nov. 19, but plenty of eager gamers are taking advantage of the New Zealand trick to play the game early. Even though GTA 6 reviews only dropped a few hours ago, players are already getting up to plenty of hijinks in Leonida. Just like in Red Dead Redemption 2, it seems like there are plenty of ways for a sincere oopsie or button fumble to spiral out of control pretty fast.

item.title: Magic: the Gathering Is Officially Reprinting an Iconic $42 Artifact with Perfect Dune Art
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: The Dune Secret Lair Superdrop features nine new cards and valuable reprints. Here's a look at every card.
item.content:encoded: That scary box that the Bene Gesserit forced Paul Atreides to put his hand into is about to make your Magic: The Gathering artifacts a lot harder to destroy. Pain Box appears in Magic's new Dune-themed Secret Lair as a new reprint of Darksteel Forge, a powerful $42 card that gives all of your artifacts indestructible. That makes it one of the biggest draws of the "My Arrakis, My Superdrop" Secret Lair revealed Nov. 18, but the Superdrop is also chock-full of unique legendary creatures vying for a spot as your favorite new Commander.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering’s 10 Best Uncommon Star Trek Cards, Ranked
item.dc:creator: Ryan Epps
item.description: The most underrated uncommon cards from Magic's Star Trek set that deserve a place in your collection.
item.content:encoded: Magic: The Gathering has never been shy about crossing over with other beloved franchises, and its latest Universes Beyond set takes players into the final frontier. The Star Trek set pulls together characters, spacecraft, alien civilizations, and iconic moments from across the franchise's decades-long history, translating them into Magic’s mechanics. It's an ambitious crossover that gives longtime Trekkies plenty to get excited about, even if UB sets haven't always been embraced by Magic's more traditional player base.

item.title: GTA 6's Release Will Stress The Internet Just As Everything's Falling Apart
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: GTA 6 is releasing within days of major outages for Apple, Microsoft, and Chase Bank
item.content:encoded: In early November, some internet service providers warned their customers that pre-downloads of Grand Theft Auto 6 were causing network slowdown issues for everyone on the service. That problem became visible before millions of gamers tried to log into the same game simultaneously. A long list of recent outages and issues across industries reliant on tech and network services now makes it seem likely that the biggest game launch of all time won't go down smoothly.

item.title: 5 Big Takeaways From the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: From GTA 6 to Control and Crimson Desert, these are the conclusions for the GOTY Race and TGA 2026
item.content:encoded: Despite the dramatic timing — before Grand Theft Auto 6's release, even before reviews for Rockstar's game have been published — nominations for The Game Awards 2026 weren't very surprising. This was always going to be GTA 6's year.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem’s Game Awards Nominee Is Ready for Resident Evil 10
item.dc:creator: Matt Patches
item.description: Resident Evil Requiem was nominated for a number of TGA awards, including for Angela Sant'Albano. The actor thinks Grace could be in a sequel.
item.content:encoded: Angela Sant'Albano had never performed in a video game before Resident Evil Requiem. She'd never done motion capture, either. But after spending months physically throwing herself into the horror of Grace Ashcroft's story, she came away convinced that the medium was a perfect fit.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Boss Reveals the Next Marvel Set’s Surprising Origin Story
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Aaron Forsythe said Magic’s original narrative got ‘total buy-in’ from Marvel
item.content:encoded: Magic: The Gatheringhas already released two Universes Beyond sets based on Marvel Comics, with Marvel’s Spider-Man in 2025 and Marvel Super Heroes in 2026. The game’s designers are taking a very different approach to their third tie-in set, Darkhold Destiny, which will launch in 2027. Rather than simply making cards based on iconic characters and comic book arcs, Wizards of the Coast designers worked with Marvel to create an entirely new storyline designed with the game’s mechanics in mind. Magic’s vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon at MagicCon Atlanta that the inspiration for the new approach came from an unlikely source.

item.title: GTA 6's Game Awards Nominations Are Exactly What Everyone Predicted
item.dc:creator: Ari Notis
item.description: GTA 6 earned eight nomination at the 2026 Game Awards — the most of any nominated game, in pretty much every category it could've.
item.content:encoded: Going into Tuesday’s reveal of the 2026 Game Awards nominees, the question wasn’t whether or not Grand Theft Auto 6 would pick up any nominations. It was more about how many nominations it would get. And now that the dust has cleared, GTA 6’s Game Awards nominations rolled out pretty much…exactly as expected.

item.title: Dune Magic: The Gathering Crossover Officially Confirmed After Major Leak
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Dune is coming to Magic: The Gathering with a new Secret Lair superdrop featuring new legendary creatures and reprints.
item.content:encoded: The spice must flow, and so must the Secret Lair drops. After several days of leaks circulating online, Dune is officially crossing over with Magic: The Gathering, with Wizards of the Coast teasing the collaboration through the official MTG Secret Lair account.

item.title: 8 Biggest Snubs in the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: The 2026 Game Awards snubbed several major games from several key categories. Here are the biggest Game Awards nominee snubs.
item.content:encoded: The Game Awards has announced its official list of nominees for this year’s prizes. Among the nominees are plenty of obvious contenders, such as Grand Theft Auto 6, Resident Evil Requiem, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. There was stiff competition across several categories, meaning that some worthy games — and Polygon favorites — didn’t make the shortlist for certain prizes. These are the biggest TGA nomination snubs of 2026.

item.title: The Mighty Nein Season 2 Officially Has Fans Worried About One Major Plot Change
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: The Mighty Nein season 2 won’t hit our screens until March, but fans are already speculating about potential changes.
item.content:encoded: The Mighty Neinseason 2 is officially set to return to our TV screens in March 2027. And while Critical Role fans may be a little put out by Amazon's new episode schedule, the season’s content has Critters excited for what’s to come from our band of lovable misfits.

item.title: Pokémon Go’s Most Cursed Crossover Officially Revealed
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Pokémon is doing a crossover with a certain language learning app.
item.content:encoded: Pokémon Go has had its share of crossovers with other brands over the past decade, including The North Face x Gucci, Major League Baseball, and Lego. The mobile gotta-catch-'em-all game's latest will bring a new critter to the game, one known to strike fear in the hearts of mobile users.

item.title: GTA 6's Rumored Lucia Actor Confirmed for Cast by Game Awards Nomination
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: The Game Awards 2026 nominees are now out. Rumored Lucia actor Manni L. Perez received a nomination for Best Performance, all-but confirming her role.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 received several nominations at The Game Awards, which were revealed on Tuesday. While GTA 6's nomination for Game of the Year wasn't too surprising, another nomination immediately stood out.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Becomes Clear Game Awards 2026 Frontrunner
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: GTA 6 leads in nominations at this year's The Game Awards, making it the obvious pick to win Game of the Year.
item.content:encoded: The Game Awards revealed its full list of nominees today, and things went as many expected: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the clear frontrunner in the 2026 Game of the Year race. GTA 6scored an impressive eight nominations, including Best Narrative, Best Action/Adventure Game, Best Game Direction, and Game of the Year. Control: Resonantis tied for second with six nominations, earning nods for Game of the Year, Best Narrative, and Best Game Direction. Resident Evil Requiem also has six nominations, including for Game of the Year.

item.title: The Game Awards Announces Game of the Year 2026 Nominees
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Game of the Year nominations have been announced for The Game Awards 2026 by host Geoff Keighley.
item.content:encoded: After months of anticipation and constant speculation, we finally know what games will duke it out for the top prize at The Game Awards 2026. Organizers for the biggest night in gaming announced this year's nominees for Game of the Year, and all the other categories, during a livestream on Tuesday, Nov. 17.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals a ‘Mind-Blowing’ Detail About Netflix’s New Series
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Netflix and Wizards are working together to get the look of each plane right
item.content:encoded: Netflix first announced it was working on a Magic: The GatheringTV series in 2019, and the project has been trapped in development hell ever since, passed between three different creative teams. Now Planeswalker is finally set to debut in 2027, and Wizards of the Coast shared a first look during a preview panel at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026. While the trailer introduced the young pyromancer Chandra Nalaar and her mentor Ajani Goldmane, Magic: The Gathering vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon in an interview at MagicCon that this won’t be a typical hero’s journey story.

item.title: Critical Role's Newest Campaign Officially Gets a Release Date and Cast Announcement
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: Critical Role's new campaign, 'Reign of the Weredragon,' will feature familiar faces and tips and tricks from Darrington Press's Chris Perkins.
item.content:encoded: Critters are in for a treat in 2027, with Critical Role’s brand-new Daggerheart miniseries, Reign of the Weredragon, premiering on Wednesday, Jan. 13 at 3 p.m. PT.
